note: REACHED ZERO 2026-09-01 -- BY DEMOTION, NOT BY PROOF. Read that twice before treating it as an achievement. The 46 greens that lacked a C3/C4/C5 referent were not given proofs; they were moved to yellow in the live-evidence recount (release/organ-ledger/2026-09-01-live-evidence-recount.md), so they no longer count as greens and the gap is vacuously 0. The five remaining greens (organs 1-5) each carry a resolvable referent or an N/A-BY-DESIGN cite for C3/C4/C5, which is why the gap is genuinely empty rather than merely small. Per this file's original terms -- 'when it reaches 0, --enforce-condition-proofs becomes the permanent default and this file can be deleted' -- the gate is now armed for real: ANY organ promoted to green from here must name a referent that runs and passes in the gate's own invocation, or it fails immediately. how_to_discharge.C3: name a test as 'tests/foo.py::test_bar' in the C3 verdict (it must run and pass in the gate's own run), or discharge with 'N/A-BY-DESIGN - path::symbol' whose cite resolves
how_to_discharge.C4: same as C3 -- both are defined as '... (or N/A-BY-DESIGN with cite)'
how_to_discharge.C5: must be positively proven with a named test; C5's definition carries no N/A-BY-DESIGN clause, and inventing one would be the exact failure mode this gate exists to catch
